name: TrueFitRecommendation
summary: True Fit Recommendation WebView SDK for iOS.
description:
Drop-in SwiftUI/UIKit widget that hosts the True Fit recommendation
experience in a WebView. Place TrueFitRecommendationWidget inline on a
product page; it sizes itself and presents the size modal full screen.
